Elegant and Modern Condo in NoPa

• Exclusive Storage
• Private, Deeded Outside Area
• 3 beds and 3 baths 
• Deeded Parking 
• Chef’s Kitchen 
• Stainless Steel, Viking Appliances 
• Corian Counters 
• Engineered, Textured Hardwood Floors 
• In-unit Washer and Dryer 
• Huge Master Bed with Sitting Area and 4 closets 
• Master bath with Two Sinks, Walk-in Shower and Separate Soaking Tub with Jets 
• Modern decor, including glass and steel railing between floors and a designer gas fireplace on each level 
• Direct Access from each Bedroom to a Bathroom 
• Kitchen Pantry 
• Central Heating 
• Open Living/Dining/Entertaining Area 
• low dues 
• Great Afternoon Sun!
